Subject: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the clear walkthrough. As discussed on the call, Acme Financial needs formal confirmation that if we opt out of "training-on-customer-data" (model improvement), our customer content will not be used to further train or fine-tune Redwood models. We also want clarity on logging controls, retention windows, and whether there are options for data residency (US-only).

Attached is our internal data-handling checklist that outlines the requirements we discussed (PII handling, audit logging, retention limits). Can you confirm the following items in writing?
- Redwood will not use our submitted content to train models if we opt out.
- Short-term operational logs may be kept for debugging; specify retention period and whether logs can be disabled/trimmed.
- Data residency: requests routed to US-only capacity.
- Process and timeline for signing an opt-out form / contract amendment.

Cc'ing legal@acmefin.com for visibility. We'll aim to get the completed checklist back by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks,
Alex

Acme Financial

Hi Alex — great to speak earlier. Summary below + next steps.

Recap/confirmation:
- Opt-out scope: If Acme Financial elects the "training-on-customer-data: opt-out" option, Redwood will not use any customer-provided content (prompts, documents, transcripts, outputs) to train or improve our public models or internal fine-tuning datasets. This opt-out applies to future training; it does not retroactively alter models already trained on public data.
- Logging/retention: Operational logs (request metadata, error traces) are retained for debugging/observability by default for 30 days. We can reduce the retention to 7 days or disable persistent request/response logging for your account on Dedicated/Private deployments. For Hosted customers we can apply a logging-minimization policy tied to an opt-out contract; full disablement requires Dedicated/Private.
- Data residency: We support region pinning. For your account we can route inference to US-only capacity (us-west/us-east).

Attached is our standard opt-out form (redwood-opt-out-form.pdf). Proposed next steps:
1) Acme completes checklist and returns (you mentioned EOD Tue).
2) Redwood legal (Rishi) and your legal review the opt-out form — we can accept a signed DocuSign or a contract amendment.
3) Once signed, we will apply opt-out flags to your account and confirm configuration (logging retention, routing) within 3 business days for Dedicated customers; for Hosted it may take 5-7 business days depending on routing.

If you prefer, we can stand up a short tech call with our security engineer (David Kim) to walk through logging and audit controls.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Alex — David from Redwood Security here. Thanks for sending the completed checklist. A few quick clarifications from our side so the opt-out implementation is smooth:

- Operational logs vs customer content:
  * Customer content: any user-supplied prompt, document, transcript, or model output associated with your account. These will be excluded from training when the opt-out flag is set.
  * Operational logs: short-term request metadata (timestamps, request ids, performance traces) used for debugging and billing. We do not persist full request/response pairs in long-term logs for Dedicated accounts once opt-out is enabled; by default those traces expire after 30 days.

- Hosted minimization policy: For Hosted customers we can apply a "logging-minimization" configuration that reduces retention to 7 days and strips response payloads from logs. Full disablement of request/response logging requires Dedicated or Private deployment. We'll document the selected option in the opt-out amendment.

- Data residency: We will note your US-only routing preference in the opt-out amendment. For Hosted accounts we will set routing policy to prioritize US regions; for Dedicated we can guarantee US-only capacity.

Next steps for Redwood security/ops:
1) Rishi (legal) to coordinate the amendment + DocuSign.
2) Once signed, security will apply opt-out flags and confirm logging settings within 3 business days.
3) Implementation note: please provide the account ID (or HubSpot Deal ID) and the primary contact for deployment scheduling.

If you'd like, we can set a 30-minute tech session tomorrow to walk your security team through retention settings and audit log exports.

Thanks,
David Kim
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
